code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == 3 for row in grid)]
    rstarts = [0] + [i + 1 for i in rows]
    cstarts = [0] + [j + 1 for j in cols]
    rends = rows + [len(grid)]
    cends = cols + [len(grid[0])]
    tiles = [tuple(tuple(row[a:b]) for row in grid[c:d])
             for c, d in zip(rstarts, rends) for a, b in zip(cstarts, cends)]
    common = Counter(tiles).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if any(tile[i][j] != v for tile in tiles) else v
             for j, v in enumerate(row)] for i, row in enumerate(common)]
'''
